title: Fix post-signup home API errors
summary: Clear stale gym/member localStorage on login/register/logout and defer scoped API calls until server gym list and members are loaded.
testFocus: After signup or login on a browser that had a previous session: home loads without 403 spam on /users/me/gyms/*/members, /history, /favorites. Empty recent/favorites states show normally.
productionChecks: Register new account → open home → DevTools Network: no 403 burst on members/history/favorites

deploy.frontend: GitHub Pages via push to main

asIs: Signup/login reused persisted gym/member IDs from localStorage before /users/me/gyms resolved, causing forbidden requests and console error spam.
toBe: Auth boundaries reset gym scope; home waits for server gym list + member fetch before favorites/history queries.
